title: Statement of Solidarity with the People of Venezuela
description: ActionAid Association strongly condemns the military aggression and external political interference directed against Caracas and other parts of Venezuela. These actions constitute a grave violation of national sovereignty and international law, and represent yet another expression of coercive power exercised against a sovereign nation of the Global South.
